items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Tommy Dorsey only in the context of other musicians (Jimmy Dorsey, Red Wooten) who were associated with him, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself and Tommy Dorsey.

ctx.x: Yeah, oh yeah. Well everybody did in those early days. Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey --
Yeah, that's where the work was --
